summary: Make reference deployment drain, replay and recovery procedures explicit
details: Document bounded private operator receipts and authorized single-job replay with explicit idempotency keys and durable outcome review.
Specify Compose and Helm stop/drain-before-migrate commands, prior-pod owner review, retained Job/audit inspection and planned single-writer outage boundaries.
Connect paired backup/object recovery to tenant-scoped checkpoints, role/operation-history restoration, current worker reconciliation binaries and post-recovery telemetry.
Replace obsolete long-lived release-signing-key advice with the current protected-workflow trust procedure, and explain restart-based infrastructure credential rotation.

Extend capacity failure guidance for active schema leases, interrupted managed migrations, restrictive network peers, private-file permissions, disruption budgets and whole-page dead-letter conflicts.

compatibility.notes: Documentation only. Commands require the target authenticated release, private configured credentials, reviewed resource names and the existing operator-owned deployment and recovery controls. No live deployment, credential rotation, provider settings or evidence records are changed.

security: Keep credentials outside command arguments and receipts private. Preserve migration coordination, append-only audit, lease fencing, replay idempotency and paired-generation recovery. Neither liveness, replay acceptance, backlog counts nor Secret names establish business integrity or provider authority.
limitations: Local source, shell syntax and project checks do not replace an operator rehearsal on the target cluster, object-store snapshot mechanism, KMS/provider or backup scheduler.
EVY-1206 completion remains subject to required migration/deployment/restore/production and final gates with recorded evidence; this fragment alone is not completion evidence.
